method: Frozen agent transcript review compared against the deployed Chrome extension local API with real Laya. Time-weighted overlap on caption-covered intervals; unknown reference regions excluded from precision/recall and reported separately.

classifier.status: Conservative fallback: the experimental five-choice classifier failed held-out accuracy checks. Automatic skipping is disabled.

limitations: One agent review; no independent human labels or full visual review.
All ten selected videos contain substantial topic-relevant material, so rejection of wholly low-value videos is not tested.
Seven videos are from Fireship; creator/style balance is limited.
Technical and news claims are assessed for relevance, not independently fact-checked.
Automatic skipping was disabled; zero executed skips cannot establish safe skip accuracy.
This is a fresh sample audit of the four-choice production fallback; it does not replace or invalidate the historical five-choice failure.
Mixed and uncertain passages may be safely retained but still absent from Useful only; highlight recall measures that omission.
